item.title: Haruki no Saidai no Teki wa Risei.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Toki Nokogiri!
  • 発売日: 2021-09-13
  • スコア: 7.609999999999999/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ハルキの最大の敵は理性。
  • 英語名: Haruki no Saidai no Teki wa Risei.

别名

  • ハルキの最大の敵は理性。-Dream Lovers Collection-

あらすじ

The girl he’s in love with is coming over to his place, alone. Tagokoro Haruki decides on Saturday to prepare for this situation.

Haruki is a virgin, as his raging boner in the morning can prove, and his step-sister — Tagokoro Anne — plots to fool around with his fluttering heart. This leads to him skipping his Saturday shift…
